inventory.name: [Nopalcyber][AI SIEM] Repeated Internet Connections to Critical Internal Service

native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.description: Detects a single external IP making 30+ connections within an hour to an internal remote-admin, file-sharing or database service (SSH, Telnet, SMB, RDP, MSSQL, MySQL, VNC, WinRM). Indicates brute-force or automated attacks on an internet-exposed service.
native_rule.name: [Nopalcyber][AI SIEM] Repeated Internet Connections to Critical Internal Service

scheduledParams.query:
dataSource.name = 'FortiGate' event.type = 'traffic' unmapped.srcintfrole = 'wan' unmapped.action != 'deny'
tranport in ('22','23','445','1433','3306','3389','5900','5985','5986')
!(src_endpoint.ip matches '^(10\\.|172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\.|192\\.168\\.|127\\.|169\\.254\\.)')
| group sessions = count() by src_endpoint.ip, src_endpoint.location.country, tranip, tranport
| filter sessions >= 30
| sort -sessions

native_rule.scopeName: Nopal Support Services Pvt. Ltd., / NopalCyber
native_rule.statusReason: Rule was activated by bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com and will become Active within an hour
